post.description:
This endpoint queries the indexer/aggregator for each provided account cap
and returns a normalized `PerpetualsAccountCap` object per account.

200.description: Successfully fetched perpetuals account caps for the given account IDs

500.description: Internal server error. The response body is a plain-text error identifier, e.g. "Error with ID: #6929e7b8536664f31a7d6112". Share this ID with the team for debugging.

post.summary: Fetch the latest base and collateral prices for one or more perpetuals markets.

AccountNumber.description:
The numerical account id.

There can only be one `capability` and one `account` for each account number.

Each account number uniquely identifies a position in a market. Thus, there can
only be one position in each market for a given account number.

ApiPerpetualsMarketFundingHistoryRequest.description:
Request payload for fetching historical funding data for a given perpetuals market.

The time range is specified with Unix timestamps in **milliseconds**.

fromTimestamp.description: Start of the time range to query, Unix timestamp in **milliseconds**.

limit.description:
Maximum number of funding points to return.

Defaults to `DEFAULT_PERPETUALS_HISTORY_LIMIT` if omitted.

marketId.description:
Identifier of the perpetuals market whose funding history you want to fetch.

Must be a valid on-chain market ID; validated by `assert_valid_id`.

toTimestamp.description: End of the time range to query, Unix timestamp in **milliseconds**.

ApiPerpetualsMarketFundingHistoryRespons.description: Response payload for historical funding data.

history.description: List of funding history datapoints for the requested market and time range.

ChId.description:
The object ID of the clearing house on Sui.

This can be obtained from `Market.id`; see `/ccxt/markets`.

error_code.description: Error code identifying the type of error

short_message.description: Optional short error message for UI display

currency.description: Usually base currency for buys, quote currency for sells

HistoricalMarketDataRequest.description:
Request payload for fetching historical candle (OHLCV) data for a given perpetuals market.

The time range is specified with Unix timestamps in **milliseconds** and candles are bucketed
by `intervalMs`.

fromTimestamp.description: Start of the time range to query, Unix timestamp in **milliseconds**.

marketId.description:
Identifier of the perpetuals market whose candles you want to fetch.

Must be a valid on-chain market ID; validated by `assert_valid_id`.

resolution.description: Candle resolution as a CCXT-style timeframe label (e.g. `"1m"`, `"5m"`, `"1h"`, `"1d"`).

toTimestamp.description: End of the time range to query, Unix timestamp in **milliseconds**.

MarketPriceResponse.description: Latest pricing information for a single market.

basePrice.description:
Latest base asset price for this market.

Typically sourced from oracle/indexer data.

collateralPrice.description: Latest collateral asset price used in this market.

markPrice.description:
Mark price used for liquidations and risk calculations.

This price is designed to reduce manipulation risk and short-term
volatility impact. It is computed as the median of:
- The index TWAP (time-weighted average price),
- The current book-derived price, and
- The index price adjusted for funding contributions.

The mark price is the canonical price used for liquidation checks.

midPrice.description:
Mid price derived from the current order book.

Calculated as the average of the best bid and best ask.
Returns `None` if either side of the book is empty.

MarketsPricesRequestBody.description: Request payload for fetching the latest base and collateral prices for one or more perpetuals markets.

marketIds.description:
List of market identifiers to fetch prices for.

Each ID must be a valid on-chain market ID; validated by `assert_valid_id`.

MarketsPricesResponseBody.description: Response payload for fetching market prices.

marketsPrices.description: Latest prices for each requested market.

Order.description:
CCXT's [Order Structure](https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/wiki/Manual#order-structure)

- The `status` of an order is usually either `'open'` (not filled or partially filled), `'closed'` (fully filled), or `'canceled'` (unfilled and canceled, or partially filled then canceled).
- Some exchanges allow the user to specify an expiration timestamp upon placing a new order. If the order is not filled by that time, its `status` becomes `'expired'`.
- Use the `filled` value to determine if the order is filled, partially filled or fully filled, and by how much.
- The work on `'fee'` info is still in progress, fee info may be missing partially or entirely, depending on the exchange capabilities.
- The `fee` currency may be different from both traded currencies (for example, an ETH/BTC order with fees in USD).
- The `lastTradeTimestamp` timestamp may have no value and may be `undefined/None/null` where not supported by the exchange or in case of an open order (an order that has not been filled nor partially filled yet).
- The `lastTradeTimestamp`, if any, designates the timestamp of the last trade, in case the order is filled fully or partially, otherwise `lastTradeTimestamp` is `undefined/None/null`.
- Order `status` prevails or has precedence over the `lastTradeTimestamp`.
- The `cost` of an order is: `{ filled * price }`
- The `cost` of an order means the total *quote* volume of the order (whereas the `amount` is the *base* volume). The value of `cost` should be as close to the actual most recent known order cost as possible. The `cost` field itself is there mostly for convenience and can be deduced from other fields.
- The `clientOrderId` field can be set upon placing orders by the user with [custom order params](#custom-order-params). Using the `clientOrderId` the user can later distinguish between own orders. This is only available for the exchanges that do support `clientOrderId` at this time.

#### timeInForce

The `timeInForce` field may be `undefined/None/null` if not specified by the exchange. The unification of `timeInForce` is a work in progress.

Possible values for the`timeInForce` field:

- `'GTC'` = _Good Till Cancel(ed)_, the order stays on the orderbook until it is matched or canceled.
- `'IOC'` = _Immediate Or Cancel_, the order has to be matched immediately and filled either partially or completely, the unfilled remainder is canceled (or the entire order is canceled).
- `'FOK'` = _Fill Or Kill_, the order has to get fully filled and closed immediately, otherwise the entire order is canceled.
- `'PO'` = _Post Only_, the order is either placed as a maker order, or it is canceled. This means the order must be placed on orderbook for at at least time in an unfilled state. The unification of `PO` as a `timeInForce` option is a work in progress with unified exchanges having `exchange.has['createPostOnlyOrder'] == True`.

oneOf.description: Unix timestamp of the most recent trade on this order

price.description: float price in quote currency (may be empty for market orders)

timestamp.description: order placing/opening Unix timestamp in milliseconds

OrderbookItem.description: Single level in the orderbook consisting of a price and size.

size.description: Size at this price level in base units.

marketId.description: ID of the associated market for the orderbook.

orderbook.description: State of the perpetuals market's orderbook.

PendingOrder.description: Summary of a pending order associated with a position.

clientOrderId.description:
Client-managed order id this order was tagged with, if any.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"` (e.g. `123_u64` → `"123n"`),
or `null` when the order carries no client order id.

currentSize.description:
Current order size remaining in base lots.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"` (e.g. `100_u64` → `"100n"`).

initialSize.description:
Initial order size in base lots.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"` (e.g. `100_u64` → `"100n"`).

orderId.description:
Unique order identifier.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"` (e.g. `123_u128` → `"123n"`).

side.description:
Order side encoded as a numeric enum.

* `0` – Bid (buy)
* `1` – Ask (sell)

Note: this field is *not* serialized with a trailing `"n"`.

PerpetualsAccountCap.description:
Capability object that links a wallet address to a perpetuals trading
account, including collateral and underlying Sui object metadata.

This is typically derived from the on-chain `AccountCap` and related objects.

accountId.description:
Numerical account identifier for the perpetuals account.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"` to match on-chain / SDK
conventions (e.g. `1_u64` → `"1n"`).

accountObjectId.description:
Sui object ID of the underlying perpetuals `Account` object associated
with this capability.

accountObjectInitialSharedVersion.description:
Initial shared version of the underlying perpetuals `Account` object.

Required when constructing transactions that reference the shared account object.

collateral.description:
Amount of collateral held by this account, in collateral units.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"` (e.g. `1000_u64` → `"1000n"`).

collateralCoinType.description:
Fully-qualified Sui type of the collateral coin for this account.

Example: `"0x2::sui::SUI"` or a USDC type string.

isAgent.description: True if this account cap was allocated to an agent wallet from the admin account cap owner.

objectDigest.description: Sui object digest (hash) of the account cap object.

objectId.description: Sui object ID of the account cap object.

objectVersion.description:
Version of the underlying Sui object that represents the account cap.

This is the Sui object version at the time of retrieval.

walletAddress.description: Sui wallet address that owns this account capability.

whitelistedAgentCapIds.description:
Sui object IDs of agent account caps that have been whitelisted to
operate on behalf of this account.

PerpetualsAccountObject.description:
High-level view of a trader's perpetuals account, including equity,
collateral, and open positions.

accountId.description:
Numerical account identifier.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"` (e.g. `1_u64` → `"1n"`).

availableCollateral.description:
Available collateral in native collateral units.

This is the portion of collateral that can still be used to open or
increase positions.

positions.description: List of open positions for this account across all markets.

totalEquityUsd.description:
Total account equity denominated in USD.

Includes collateral, realized PnL, and unrealized PnL/funding.

totalUnrealizedFundingsUsd.description:
Total unrealized funding (positive or negative) across all open positions,
denominated in USD.

totalUnrealizedPnlUsd.description:
Total unrealized profit and loss (PnL) across all open positions,
denominated in USD.

PerpetualsAccountObjectBody.description: Request payload for fetching perpetuals account caps given a list of account IDs.

PerpetualsAccountPositionsBody.description: Request payload for fetching open positions for one or more accounts.

accountIds.description:
List of numerical account IDs for which to fetch positions.

Deserialized from an array of strings with trailing `"n"` (e.g. `["1n", "2n"]`).

marketIds.description:
Optional list of market (clearing house) IDs to filter positions by.

When omitted or empty, positions across all markets are returned.

PerpetualsAccountPositionsResponse.description: Response payload for fetching account positions.

accounts.description: Account summaries and their open positions.

PerpetualsAccountsResponse.description: Response payload for fetching perpetuals account caps by account IDs.

accountCaps.description: Perpetuals account caps (and associated account metadata) for the requested account IDs.

PerpetualsMarketCandleDataPoint.description: Single OHLCV datapoint for a perpetuals market at a given time bucket.

timestamp.description: Candle timestamp in **milliseconds** since Unix epoch.

volume.description: Traded volume during this interval, in base asset units.

PerpetualsMarketCandleHistoryResponse.description: Response payload for historical candle data.

candles.description: List of candle datapoints (OHLCV) for the requested market and time buckets.

PerpetualsMarketFundingHistoryPoint.description:
Single funding rate datapoint for a perpetuals market at a given timestamp.

Funding rate fields are expressed as fractions: `0.01` = `1%`.

cumulativeLongFundingRate.description:
Cumulative funding rate accrued by long positions up to this point,
as a fraction (e.g. `0.01` = `1%`).

cumulativeShortFundingRate.description:
Cumulative funding rate accrued by short positions up to this point,
as a fraction (e.g. `0.01` = `1%`).

longFundingRate.description:
Funding rate applied to long positions for this period, as a fraction
(e.g. `0.01` = `1%`).

shortFundingRate.description:
Funding rate applied to short positions for this period, as a fraction
(e.g. `0.01` = `1%`).

timestamp.description: Timestamp at which this funding point was recorded, in **milliseconds**.

txDigest.description: Sui transaction digest associated with this funding event.

PerpetualsMarketsRequest.description: Request payload for fetching one or more perpetuals markets.

marketIds.description:
Market identifiers to fetch. Omit or leave empty to fetch all markets.

Each provided ID must be a valid on-chain market ID; validated by `assert_valid_id`.

PerpetualsMarketsResponse.description: Response payload for fetching markets' orderbooks.

orderbooks.description: List of orderbooks returned for the request.

PerpetualsOrderbook.description: Snapshot of the top-level orderbook for a perpetuals market.

asks.description: List of ask (sell) orders, typically sorted by increasing price.

asksTotalSize.description: Total size of all asks, in base units.

bids.description: List of bid (buy) orders, typically sorted by decreasing price.

bidsTotalSize.description: Total size of all bids, in base units.

midPrice.description: Mid price between best bid and best ask, if both sides are non-empty.

nonce.description:
Monotonically increasing nonce representing this orderbook snapshot
version.

Serialized as a string with a trailing `"n"`.

PerpetualsOwnedAccountObjectBody.description: Request payload for fetching perpetuals account caps owned by a given wallet.

collateralCoinTypes.description:
Optional filter of collateral coin types.

When provided, only accounts whose collateral coin type is in this list will be returned.

walletAddress.description:
Wallet address owning the perpetuals account caps.

Must be a valid Sui address; validated by `assert_valid_id`.

PerpetualsOwnedAccountsResponse.description: Response payload for fetching perpetuals account caps owned by a wallet.

accountCaps.description: Perpetuals account caps (and associated account metadata) owned by the wallet.

PerpetualsPosition.description: Detailed information about a single open position in a perpetuals market.

asksQuantity.description: Base asset amount resting in ask (sell) orders on the orderbook for this position.

baseAssetAmount.description:
Perpetual contract size / exposure to the underlying asset.

Positive values represent a long position; negative values represent a short.

bidsQuantity.description: Base asset amount resting in bid (buy) orders on the orderbook for this position.

collateral.description: Amount of collateral allocated to this position (in collateral units).

collateralUsd.description: Collateral allocated to this position denominated in USD.

cumFundingRateLong.description:
Last long cumulative funding rate applied to this position.

The difference between the market's current long cumulative funding rate
and this value determines the funding that must be paid/received.

cumFundingRateShort.description: Last short cumulative funding rate applied to this position.

entryPrice.description: Average entry price of the position.

freeCollateral.description:
Portion of account collateral that remains free after accounting for this
position, in collateral units.

freeMarginUsd.description:
Free margin in USD that can still be used to grow the position or open
new ones.

leverage.description: Effective leverage of the position (position notional / collateral).

liquidationPrice.description:
Estimated liquidation price for the position.

If the market price crosses this level, the position may be liquidated.

marginRatio.description:
Margin ratio for the position (collateral vs. position risk).

Used to determine liquidation risk relative to initial and maintenance
margin requirements.

marketId.description: Identifier of the market (e.g., base asset symbol or internal market ID).

pendingOrders.description: Pending (resting) orders associated with this position.

quoteAssetNotionalAmount.description: Notional value of the position (including leverage) in quote units.

unrealizedFundingsUsd.description: Unrealized funding on this position, denominated in USD.

unrealizedPnlUsd.description: Unrealized profit and loss on this position, denominated in USD.

Timestamp.description:
Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

NOTE: safe since the UNIX timestamp shouldn't pass u53::MAX in a long time. Therefore
**serializing** this to JSON/BSON shouldn't be a problem, moreover the client can then expect
an 'integer'.

info.description:
# Overview

Aftermath currently maintain two sets of API: Aftermath REST API and Aftermath CCXT API. For more info about our CCXT API, head over to our [docs](https://docs.aftermath.finance/for-developers/api/ccxt). CCXT also maintains documentation for the Aftermath CCXT integration [here](https://docs.ccxt.com/#/exchanges/aftermath).
